FIRST AVENUE - SELLS INVESTMENT UNITS IN LA PERLE FUND FOR 131 MILLION  RIYALS

FIRST AVENUE- DEAL IN EXCHANGE FOR ACQUISITION OF AWJ’S ENTIRE HOLDING OF INVESTMENT UNITS IN AL SHATI REAL ESTATE FUND
FIRST AVENUE- UNDER AGREEMENT, FIRST AVENUE’S OWNERSHIP STAKE IN AL SHATI REAL ESTATE FUND WILL INCREASE FROM 32.7% TO APPROXIMATELY 81.6%

FIRST AVENUE- COMPANY EXPECTS TO RECOGNIZE A GAIN OF SAR 3.6 MILLION
